summary: Learn enterprise architecture for business leaders with TOGAF, ArchiMate, roadmaps, and governance workshops. Build practical EA outputs.
lede: Enterprise architecture for business leaders connects business strategy with architecture decisions, capabilities, technology, and change roadmaps. It is for enterprise architects, business architects, IT strategy managers, and transformation program managers who need to guide investment and transformation decisions. Learners practice assessing current and target states, mapping capabilities, prioritizing roadmaps, and designing governance, using TOGAF ADM and ArchiMate to communicate architecture choices.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to connect enterprise architecture decisions to business strategy, transformation sequencing, and governance. It is especially relevant if you work between business leaders and technical teams and must explain architecture in practical terms.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of business operations, transformation projects, or IT change initiatives; familiarity with basic architecture concepts is helpful but not mandatory. You do not need coding skills, and no programming is required to complete the exercises. Participants should bring a laptop for template-based workshops and be prepared to review sample capability maps, architecture principles, roadmap slides, and governance checklists.
